description: This file implements a webhook server for Telegram integration, including server setup, request handling, security checks, and webhook configuration.

classes.name: InputFileFallback
classes.description: Fallback class for grammy.InputFile when it is not a function, used to handle file input paths.

methods.name: listenHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server and resolves when it is listening or rejects on error.

methods.name: resolveWebhookPublicUrl
methods.description: Determines the public URL for the webhook, either from configuration or by constructing it from server info.

methods.name: initializeTelegramWebhookBot
methods.description: Initializes the Telegram bot by calling its init method with error logging.

methods.name: resolveSingleHeaderValue
methods.description: Extracts a single string value from a header that may be a string or array.

methods.name: hasValidTelegramWebhookSecret
methods.description: Checks if the provided secret header matches the expected secret using secure comparison.

methods.name: parseIpLiteral
methods.description: Parses an IP address or literal from a string, handling IPv4, IPv6, and enclosed IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: isTrustedProxyAddress
methods.description: Determines if an IP address is within a list of trusted proxies, supporting CIDR notation.

methods.name: resolveForwardedClientIp
methods.description: Resolves the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For header, considering trusted proxies.

methods.name: resolveTelegramWebhookClientIp
methods.description: Determines the client IP address for a webhook request, considering trusted proxies and headers.

methods.name: resolveTelegramWebhookRateLimitKey
methods.description: Generates a rate limit key based on request path and client IP.

methods.name: startTelegramWebhook
methods.description: Sets up and starts a Telegram webhook server with configuration, security, and lifecycle management.
